text:
The missing key is `rate`. The settings file defines a misspelled key, `"rat"`, at `settings.json:2`.

`app/config.py:7-10` loads `settings.json` from the project root. `SETTINGS.get("rate")` at `app/pricing.py:8` therefore returns `None`.

The fix would be to rename `"rat"` to `"rate"` on line 2. I haven't changed any files.
